description: This file defines API routes related to authentication in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for user login, OAuth2 token retrieval, and fetching the current authenticated user. The functionality involves verifying user credentials, generating JWT tokens, and returning user data.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Pydantic model representing JWT access token and token type.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for login credentials containing username and password.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for representing safe user details.

methods.name: Token login( credentials: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Authenticates a user using username and password, returns a JWT token if successful.

methods.name: Token oauth2_token( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Provides OAuth2 compatible token retrieval using form data.

methods.name: UserOut read_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user()))
methods.description: Retrieves details of the currently authenticated user.

ctags.name: oauth2_token
ctags.signature: ( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
